Session 2 turn 2. Suspect input bug from last trace: tick #0 'down+right' from (1,1) ended at (1,2) with events [move,bump]. Per design only the last movement key (right) counts, and it should move to (2,1) (floor). Observed looks like down was applied, then right was applied from (1,2) and bumped into wall (2,2). That violates one-move-per-tick. Next: replay 'down+right' alone from fresh seed 7 to confirm (expect P(2,1), no bump). Then compare 'right+down' (expect P(1,2)). If confirmed, minimize and file as input_race. Existing reports: 2 key-lost-on-respawn bugs (seed 42), do not refile. Still unexplored: lever/gates, exit, timer at 0, score cap, Game over dialog, Enter on dialogs.

Session 2, turn 5. Confirmed the movement-order bug on seed 7. From the start (1,1), a single tick of right+down ended at (2,1), a right move, in runs 3 and 4. This is a single-token repro, so no further cutting is needed. Filing it as input_race. Earlier reports (2 key-lost-on-respawn reports, seed 42) were filed in previous turns and are not repeated.

reports.title: Same-tick movement keys: first pressed direction wins instead of last
reports.observed: Pressing right+down in one tick from (1,1) moves the player right to (2,1). Pressing down+right in one tick moves the player down to (1,2). The first key pressed in the tick wins.
reports.expected: Of the movement keys pressed in a tick, only the last one counts. right+down should move the player down to (1,2); down+right should move right to (2,1).
